description: Convert CSV or TSV text, or a base64 file, into clean, validated XML 1.0. Finds the separator (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe) and the encoding (UTF-8, UTF-16, Windows-1252, Windows-1251), turns column names into valid XML names (spaces, symbols, leading digits and duplicates fixed), writes columns as child elements or attributes, and handles empty cells as empty tags, omitted, or xsi:nil. Pretty or minified. Deterministic, 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/csv-to-xml.

examples.csv:
Order ID;Customer;Total (EUR)
A-100;Atlas Garage;146,00
A-101;Müller & Söhne;54,40

columnsAs.description: Write each column as a child element or as an attribute of the row

csv.description: CSV or TSV text to convert (empty = built-in sample orders table)

delimiter.description: Column separator; auto finds it from the first rows

emptyCells.description: Empty cells: empty tag, left out, or xsi:nil='true' (elements only)

fileContent.description: Optional base64-encoded .csv / .tsv / .txt file (max 5 MB), used instead of csv

hasHeader.description: First row holds the column names (false = columns are named col_1, col_2 ...)

rowName.description: Element name for each CSV row

name: csv_to_xml
title: CSV to XML API - convert CSV or TSV into validated XML 1.0
